mstts:express-as.prosody: Welcome—I'm so glad you're here. You know, we’re often told that capitalism is this perfect machine—always delivering prosperity, sparking innovation, and guaranteeing our freedom. But what if the story isn’t quite that simple? Together, we're about to peel back the layers and dig beneath those polished headlines, exploring the real forces that shape our everyday lives and the world economy. Inspired by Ha-Joon Chang’s eye-opening book, 23 Things They Don't Tell You About Capitalism, we’ll challenge the familiar myths and question the assumptions that have shaped the way we think about markets, opportunity, and fairness. Imagine discovering that so much of what we've heard about free markets and self-regulation comes from policies and ideals—rather than any sort of natural law. As we journey through global finance, labor markets, and the subtle hand of government, you’ll see how each “thing” Chang shares shines a new light on the stories we take for granted. From the idea of meritocracy, to the hidden support behind big innovations, we’ll discover how success isn’t just about individual effort—it’s shaped by the choices we make as a society, by our history, and by who gets to write the rules. So, if you’re ready to see capitalism in a whole new way—and maybe even rethink what’s possible for the future—let’s dive in together. Here’s to questioning what we’ve been told, and uncovering the real story behind prosperity, fairness, and change.
